policy.description: Maintain OrcaTeal as a pinned coding-server fork; treat upstream as a selective donor and carry only workflow-critical Teal patches.
policy.requiredTopology: Air Raid UI -> Ultra Magnus runtime -> fleet SSH hosts
policy.forbiddenTopology: Air Raid UI -> Ultra Magnus runtime -> Air Raid SSH
policy.upstreamReviewRule: Never rebase the maintained branch onto upstream. Evaluate upstream changes on disposable branches and cherry-pick only explicitly approved commits after the coding-server continuity matrix passes.
